statements.subject: session
statements.description: Event 14: TcpConnection_Valid — Event indicating the local system reception of a TCP connection request with a valid source IP address, TCP port, destination IP address, and TCP Port.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The TrackTcpState attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE if Event 14 (TcpConnection_Valid) occurs.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Event 15: Tcp_CR_Invalid — Event indicating the local system reception of a TCP connection request with either an invalid source address or port number, or an invalid destination address or port number.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The TrackTcpState attribute should be set to TRUE if Event 15 (Tcp_CR_Invalid) occurs.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Event 16: Tcp_CR_Acked — Event indicating the local system's request to establish a TCP connection to the remote peer. The local system's TCP connection sent a TCP SYN, received a TCP SYN/ACK message, and sent a TCP ACK.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Event 17: TcpConnectionConfirmed — Event indicating that the local system has received a confirmation that the TCP connection has been established by the remote site. The remote peer's TCP engine sent a TCP SYN. The local peer's TCP engine sent a SYN, ACK message and now has received a final ACK.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Event 18: TcpConnectionFails — Event indicating that the local system has received a TCP connection failure notice. The remote BGP peer's TCP machine could have sent a FIN, or the local peer indicated a timeout in the TCP connection and downed the connection.
